title: Mobility Visits by Transportation Level of Service (Primary Care Provider Assignment)
content:
**Primary Care Provider Assignment — mobility visits on a second-opinion referral.**

Mobility visits are added to a second-opinion referral's visits, before the single-referral visit ceiling is applied, according to the level of service of the member's active transportation benefit under **Non-Emergency Medical Transportation**: RideLink Wheelchair Van or RideLink Stretcher Van adds the two-visit mobility allowance, RideLink Door-to-Door Assist or RideLink Ambulatory Sedan adds the one-visit mobility allowance, and any other level, or no active benefit, adds nothing.

| Level of service of the active transportation benefit | Mobility visits added |
|---|---|
| RideLink Stretcher Van | 2 |
| RideLink Wheelchair Van | 2 |
| RideLink Door-to-Door Assist | 1 |
| RideLink Ambulatory Sedan | 1 |
| RideLink Mileage Reimbursement | 0 |
| RideLink Transit Pass | 0 |
| No active transportation benefit | 0 |

**Reading the table (hypothetical members)**

- A member whose active benefit is RideLink Wheelchair Van: 2 mobility visits.
- A member whose active benefit is RideLink Ambulatory Sedan: 1 mobility visit.
- A member whose RideLink Stretcher Van benefit is no longer active and who holds no other active benefit: no active benefit, no mobility visit.
